title: The Orchard — Atomadic product catalog
excerpt: Every Atomadic product line in one view. Living tool-sets emitted by a deterministic engine — one MCP, one key, all current and future tools.
content_html:
The Orchard · grown by the engine

Every tool is a fruit.
The tree keeps growing.

Atomadic products aren't feature lists frozen at launch — they're living tool-sets emitted by a deterministic engine that grows on every breath. The Orchard is the whole catalog in one view.

The Orchard law: we never sell tool counts. Every plan includes all the tools its products carry — current and future. When the engine grows a new tool, it lands in your entitlement automatically. No re-integration, no upsell per tool, ever.

The product lines

Twelve lines, one MCP, one key. Each card opens the full product page; live tool lists render from the deployed catalog — never hard-coded.

💡

Request a Custom Tool from SROS Engine

Have an idea for a custom AI compliance, security firewall, or code transformation tool? Submit your specification directly to the SROS Zero-LLM Invention Flywheel. The engine synthesizes, gate-tests, and mints it live into the catalog within minutes.

🔍 Check Existing Ticket Status

Growing now — the v11 season

The next harvest is being emitted by our deterministic engine. Chips flip from [aspirational] to live only with a receipt — no launch theater.

livev11 serve surface — the engine's own registry over MCP, entitlement-shaped tool discovery, default-deny.

liveEntitlement issuer — Ed25519 keys verified at the edge against the published issuer pubkey.

liveReceipt-per-call — every governed call returns a verifiable receipt id on an append-only stream.

livex402 metering v2 — overage + agent-to-agent settlement from the same gated primitives Catalyst sells.

lawMurmuration growth law — new engine-emitted tools land in existing entitlements automatically.

Follow the flips: the docs · live engine state

Receipt yourself

Don't take the Orchard's word for anything — the engine signs its own state, and you can verify it offline.

Closure attestation, issuer pubkey, and the machine-readable state of truth are published at:

curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-closure.json | jq .
curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-issuer-pubkey.json | jq .key
curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-state.json | jq .display

content_html_zh:
果园·由引擎种植

每一个工具都是一个果实。树不断生长。

原子产品并不是在发布时就冻结的功能列表——它们是由每次呼吸都会增长的确定性引擎发出的动态工具集。 果园是一个视图中的整个目录。

果园法则：我们从不出售工具数量。 每个计划都包含其产品所携带的所有工具——当前和未来。 当引擎开发出新工具时，它会自动进入您的权利范围内。 永远不会重新集成，每个工具都不会追加销售。

产品线

12 条线，1 个 MCP，1 个密钥。 每张卡片都会打开完整的产品页面；实时工具列表从已部署的目录中渲染 - 从未进行硬编码。

💡

从 SROS 引擎请求自定义工具

对自定义 AI 合规性、安全防火墙或代码转换工具有想法吗？ 直接将您的规格提交给 SROS 零法学硕士发明飞轮。 该引擎会在几分钟内进行综合、门测试并将其实时生成到目录中。

🔍检查现有票证状态

现在正在成长——v11 赛季

下一次收获将由我们的确定性引擎发出。 筹码从[抱负]转变为只靠收据生活——没有发射剧院。

livev11 服务表面 — 引擎自己的 MCP 注册表、权利型工具发现、默认拒绝。

liveEntitlement 发行者 — Ed25519 密钥在边缘根据已发布的发行者公钥进行验证。

liveReceipt-per-call — 每个受管控的调用都会在仅附加流上返回可验证的收据 ID。

livex402 计量 v2 — 超额 + 来自 Catalyst 销售的相同门控基元的代理间结算。

lawMurmuration增长法则——新的引擎发射工具自动登陆现有权利。

跟随翻转：文档·实时引擎状态

自己收据

不要相信 Orchard 的任何说法——引擎会签署自己的状态，您可以离线验证它。

关闭证明、发行者公钥和机器可读的事实状态发布于：

curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-closure.json | jq .
curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-issuer-pubkey.json | jq .key
curl https://mcp.atomadic.tech/.well-known/atomadic-state.json | jq .display
